title: Week of Sep 14 – Sep 20 · Foundations Week 3: Five Lifts a Night
subtitle: Same four strength nights and two easy runs. Every lift night gets a fifth lift, each one picked to cover something the plan didn't have yet, and the loads step up one notch from what you logged. Sessions should run closer to 70 minutes now instead of 35 to 45.
goals: The ask, in your words: 'I would like one more big lift.' Done, on every night. Monday adds dumbbell step-ups (single-leg work only lived on Thursday before). Tuesday adds a seated cable row (Tuesday had no pulling at all, and back strength was your other ask). Thursday adds push-ups (Thursday had no pressing). Saturday adds a lateral raise + face pull pair (shoulders and rear delts were the one thing nowhere in the week, and rear delts are back strength too). Nothing was removed.

Loads go up one notch from your log, nothing more, since you said the weights feel about right: squat 75 for every set (you hit 75 on set 3 last Thursday), barbell bench 65 (Saturday's number), barbell RDL 95 Tuesday then 100 Saturday, barbell row 50 (the bar twice was enough), pulldown 60, goblet 40, one-arm row 20s, glute bridge 30, reverse lunge 12s. Where a note says 'if smooth, take the next one', that's yours to decide set by set.

Why the sessions were short: two main lifts plus one accessory plus the hips and core blocks is about 35 minutes if the rest periods are honest. Five lifts plus hips plus core is the fix, not more sets of the same thing. If a night runs long, the hips superset and the core circuit are the last two blocks and can be cut to two rounds; the five lifts don't get cut.

Hips and core are unchanged: three hip flexor touches across the week (psoas march Monday and Saturday, hip flexor raises Thursday) and 6 bodyweight core sets every lift night. Rotation this week: dead bug / plank, side plank / bird dog, hollow hold / shoulder taps, plank / side plank.

Runs: Wednesday and Sunday, 2 miles easy, conversational. Knee note in the log either way. The bike swap is right there on the card if it complains. Strava is still not connected for your profile; the link is workoutplanning-production.up.railway.app/api/strava/connect/emma and it means runs and heart rate show up on their own.
review: Last two weeks on the Foundations Week 2 plan: Monday Aug 31 squat 70/70/70 and barbell bench 55, Tuesday Sep 1 RDL 65/85/85 and DB press 15/20/20, Thursday Sep 10 squat 70/70/75, barbell row 45, pulldown 50/50/60 and reverse lunges with 10s then 12s, Saturday Sep 12 barbell bench 65, RDL 95 and glute bridges at 25. Every barbell lift moved up inside the session, and the Thursday journal said it plainly: 'I would like one more big lift.' The sessions clocked about 35 to 45 minutes of lifting. Runs went unlogged both weeks.

days.name: Foundation A · Squat + Bench + Step-ups
warmup: 5 min easy cardio (bike, row, or brisk walk)

items.note: 75 for all three sets. You hit 75 on set 3 last Thursday, so it becomes the working weight. If all three are smooth 8s with no grinding on the last rep, 80 for set 3 on Thursday.
items.focus: Brace, chest tall, knees track over toes, squat to a depth you control.

items.note: 65, where Saturday ended. Same setup every set: shoulder blades pinned, feet flat, bar to mid-chest. If every set is an easy 8, Saturday goes to 70.
items.focus: Shoulder blades set, feet planted, lower to mid-chest, press up and slightly back.

items.note: 20s for every set (you finished there two weeks ago). Strict: no torso twist, pull to the hip, 1s squeeze.
items.focus: Flat back, pull to your hip, squeeze the shoulder blade.

items.note: NEW, lift five. A box or bench about knee height, 10-lb dumbbells at your sides. Step up through the whole foot, stand fully tall at the top (that's the hip flexor and glute rep), step down slowly. Single-leg work was only on Thursday before this; now Monday has it too. 15s next week if 10s are easy.
items.focus: Whole foot on the box, drive through the heel, no push off the back leg, control the way down.

items.note: The hips block, unchanged. No band? March slowly in place driving each knee above hip height with a 1s hold.
items.focus: Low back stays glued to the floor on the march; toes forward and hip stacked on the leg lifts.

items.note: Core block, 6 sets: dead bug → plank, three rounds, ~20s between moves.
items.focus: Ribs down, low back pressed into the floor, opposite arm and leg reach long.

items.note: 40s holds this week, up from 30 to 40.
items.focus: Straight line head to heels, glutes tight, breathe.

stretches: Kneeling hip flexor stretch, 45s each side

days.name: Foundation B · RDL + Press + Cable Row
warmup: 5 min easy cardio (bike, row, or brisk walk)

items.note: 95 for all three sets, the weight you finished at on Saturday. Slow 2–3s lowering, bar dragging the thighs, stop when the hamstrings say so. Saturday goes to 100.
items.focus: Hips back, flat back, bar close, feel the hamstrings load.

items.note: 20s for all three (you moved to 20 on sets 2 and 3 two weeks ago). Strict: no leg drive, ribs down. 25s next week if set 3 is clean.
items.focus: Squeeze glutes, ribs down, press to lockout over the ears.

items.note: 40, one step up from 35. Deliberately lighter than Monday's barbell work; this is depth and posture practice.
items.focus: Elbows inside the knees at the bottom, chest tall, heels down.

items.note: NEW, lift five. Tuesday had no pulling before this. Start at 40 on the stack, sit tall, pull the handle to the belly button with the elbows close, 1s squeeze, then let the shoulder blades slide forward under control. If 10 is easy on set 1, go up one plate for sets 2 and 3. This plus Monday's rows and Thursday's barbell rows is the back-strength answer.
items.focus: Chest up, no leaning back to finish the rep, squeeze the shoulder blades together.

items.note: The hips block, your knee insurance. Same as before, band optional on the clamshells.
items.focus: Squeeze the glute at the top of every bridge; keep the hips stacked on the clamshells.

items.note: Core block, 6 sets: side plank → bird dog, three rounds. From the knees is still a fine version.
items.focus: Hips stacked and lifted, straight line from head to feet.
Slow and square, hips level, reach long, pause 2s each rep.

stretches: Kneeling hip flexor stretch, 45s each side
